settings.heading: Keep the everyday in good shape.
settings.intro: Thoughtful handling starts with the instructions supplied with your object.

settings.heading: A few useful answers.
settings.subheading: Start here, then talk to us if you need a hand.

settings.label: Eyewear and screens
settings.content: Use the cleaning method specified for your lenses or display. Avoid abrasive materials, and store eyewear in its case when it is not in use.

settings.label: Bags and fabric
settings.content: Check the material-specific care instructions. Empty pockets before cleaning and allow damp fabric to dry fully before storing.

settings.label: Chargers, cables and docks
settings.content: Disconnect power before cleaning. Keep ports dry and free of debris; stop using a cable or device if it is visibly damaged.

settings.label: Need more specific guidance?
settings.content: Tell us the product name through the support form. Follow the manufacturer instructions for your exact model.
